title: D3.js Review Quiz
description: Review the small examples from this D3.js course. Take your time and read the reason given for each answer.

questions.question: What does append("circle") create?
questions.explanation: A D3 selection points to page elements. append creates a child element, and attr sets one of its attributes.

questions.question: What does d represent in the radius callback?
questions.explanation: A data join matches data values to elements. join creates missing elements and can later update or remove them.

questions.question: What is the domain [0,100] describing?
questions.explanation: A linear scale maps one number range to another. The domain is the data range, and the range is the drawing range.

questions.question: What does bandwidth return?
options: The speed of the internet connection
The width of one category band
questions.explanation: A band scale gives named categories separate spaces. bandwidth tells the width available for each category.

questions.question: Why is height calculated as 180-y(d)?
options: To measure from the top of the bar to the baseline
questions.explanation: A bar chart uses height to show a number. SVG y positions grow downward, so a taller bar needs a smaller top y value.

questions.question: What does text-anchor middle do?
options: Moves it to the bottom of the screen
Centres the text around its x position
questions.explanation: Text labels tell readers what a chart value means. D3 can set text from the same data used for shapes.

questions.question: What should an axis share with its data marks?
questions.explanation: An axis draws ticks and labels for a scale. Place its group at the edge of the chart where that scale should be read.

questions.question: What decides the order of the connected points?
options: Their order in the data list
questions.explanation: A line generator turns a list of points into an SVG path. Each point needs an x and y value.

questions.question: Which value makes the largest slice?
questions.explanation: A pie layout turns values into angles. An arc generator uses those angles to draw slice paths.

questions.question: What happens to the extra third circle?
questions.explanation: Calling a join again with new data updates the matching elements. Extra old elements are removed by the join.

questions.question: What is the second handler argument?
questions.explanation: D3 can attach an event handler to a shape. The handler receives the event and the datum for that shape.

questions.question: What should the text alternative communicate?
options: Only the name of the JavaScript library
The important meaning and data of the chart
questions.explanation: A visual chart should have a useful name and a text explanation. A nearby table can provide exact values to readers who cannot use the picture.
